behavior: project_id queries require dataset:read plus active project membership and active project state. Results require an explicit unexpired snapshot/project grant. Grant expiry and revocation are evaluated on every uncached request.
identity: project_members.principal_id is the UUID OIDC subject, matching Supabase Auth user IDs. Non-UUID subjects fail closed for project-filtered queries.
database: Migration 0006 adds composite tenant/project and tenant/snapshot foreign keys and default-deny tenant RLS. Trusted application methods can grant, renew and revoke access. Callers of these internal methods must authorize project sharing separately.
scope: This implements the designed project filter. Existing tenant-wide dataset:read and snapshot detail semantics are unchanged; this does not introduce project-only snapshot classification. No grant-management HTTP endpoint is added without a contract decision.
validation: Integration assertions cover membership, no grant, grant, expiry, renewal, revocation and invalid project foreign keys. HTTP tests conceal unauthorized projects and verify filter forwarding. Prior migration/security regressions remain required.
deployment: Local disposable services only; production migrations not applied.
remaining: Live scientific baseline/QC/as-of validation and full G03
